description: Print-ready posters for a job: an A4 window poster, an A5 poster for regulars and an A6 table card, each with a QR code people apply from. Takes a job made with post_job (its code or link) or a live Instead job (its link or slug).

address.description: Short address for the poster, like '14 Chatsworth Rd · E5'

job.description: The code or link post_job returned, or a live job's instead.work/j/ link

look.description: a: Loud colour; b: Till receipt; c: Chat thread

reward.description: A thank-you for a regular who sends the hire, like 'a month of free coffee'

name: make_hiring_poster
title: Make hiring posters
